blocks.text: Biohacking Market Analysis
The biohacking market is growing at a rate of 20% per year. Grand View Research says its volume will exceed 70 billion dollars by 2030.

People want to live longer, maintain high productivity, and control their health with the help of science. This uses technology, genetics, nutrition, and psychology to improve health and prolong life. And all this is happening right before our eyes – here and now. The article contains the best biohacking companies and health-tech startups that make biohacking accessible and effective for a wide audience. These companies continue to push the boundaries of [biohacking](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking) by offering innovative solutions that help people achieve better health, recovery, and energy. Each of these companies plays an important role in transforming the industry by offering products that are not only beneficial but also focused on sustainable and conscious consumption.
How Does Silicon Valley Influence Biohacking?

Silicon Valley is one of the centers of advanced technologies. The most daring ideas find their place here. And, of course, there are a lot of wealthy people who are ready to invest in innovations. So, it is not surprising that California has become one of the centers of the biohacking industry. Companies and startups located here get access to the best specialists, investments, and advanced developments, which allows them to create products that change the lives of millions of people. When talking about investing companies, it’s important to talk about venture firms such as Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, и Kleiner Perkins, the most prominent investors in Silicon Valley. Companies strive to demonstrate commercial potential and real scientific achievements, attracting investments from venture capitalists. This allows them to quickly develop and introduce new solutions to the market.

High competition in Silicon Valley also forces each company to move faster, implement new technologies, and look for new ways to improve the human body. Competition is huge. Every startup is trying to get funding from investors to grow its business.It also stimulates increasing the quality of the products, with every company not only trying to make it good but to be faster than others. In a highly competitive environment, biohacking companies often partner with large tech or pharmaceutical companies to pool resources and speed up product development. Such partnerships facilitate growth and reduce the risks of scientific research and clinical trials.

Thanks to this, biohacking is becoming not just a trend but an inevitable part of the future, in which each person can optimize themselves with the development of AI-driven healthcare and genetic engineering.
Biohacking Market Capitalization Growth Statistics

People are more and more interested in well being and awareness of their body state. And we could see it in increasing numbers. The biohacking market is growing rapidly. [According to experts](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/biohacking-market), the average annual growth rate will be 18.95% in the next few years up to 2030. Also, according to[Kings Research](https://www.kingsresearch.com/biohacking-market-822), the biohacking market size in 2023 is estimated at $22.37 billion, with an expected average annual growth rate of 20.31% from 2023 to 2031.

Nevertheless the market is hindered by challenges such as lack of studies, low awareness and quite priced products. We should not forget about strict regulations, especially concerning health claims and genetic modification. But even with these issues, interest in biohacking from regular people is getting higher. Based on analyses, it categorised into wearable implants, gene modification kits, smart drugs, supplements, gadgets, apps and others. The spectrum is wide.

Of course, there are key players in the biohacking industry that set both the pace and trends of development. These are Apple Inc., Fitbit, Inc., Nuanic, Health Via Modern Nutrition Inc and Thriveport, LLC.
These companies are actively introducing innovations in the field of biohacking, we will talk about some of them and other large companies influencing the development of biohacking below.
Leading Biohacking Companies in 2026
Bulletproof

Founded by Dave Asprey in 2013, Bulletproof is at the forefront of nutritional biohacking. The company has become an icon among people interested in biohacking. It has created an entire segment of products focused on improving physical and cognitive health through proper nutrition. With Bulletproof products, Asprey began popularizing the idea that proper nutrition can significantly improve cognitive function and increase energy levels.
Product portfolio:

items: Bulletproof coffee – a drink with oil that maintains energy and focus.
[Nootropic supplements](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/nootropics-in-biohacking-definition-examples-and-benefits) are used to improve memory, concentration, and mood.
Protein bars and collagen complexes.

blocks.text: Apple

Few people do not know about Apple, but not everyone knows how seriously the company supports the biohacking trend. Founded in 1976, It mainly focuses on the development of gadgets. Apple Watch is a smartwatch a powerful and [accurate](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-025-02238-1) tool for tracking biometrics in real-time. Also, it could be a sleep optimization tool that helps you understand this process better. From ECG monitoring to blood oxygen level tests, all this data allows users to monitor their condition and prevent diseases. Apple has made biohacking available to millions, making health monitoring an everyday task. Through Apple apps such as Health and ResearchKit, the company already collects vast amounts of data that help develop personalized recommendations for each user.

Many functions and tasks are now taken over by smartphone apps – they collect and store data from devices, provide ready-made programs and recipes, motivate, relax, and can even help you find new friends with similar sporting interests. […] [Read The Full Article](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/top-biohacking-apps-for-health-sleep-brain-food-and-body)
Root Brands

The company was founded quite a few years ago, in 2020, by Zack Bell and Clayton Thomas. The main focus of the company is cellular cleansing and restoration. Their products are aimed at eliminating toxins and regenerating cellular function. Root Brands is on a personalized approach to detoxification and actively promotes ideas about the importance of deep cleansing of the body to improve overall health.
Product portfolio:

items: Clean Slate is a supplement that cleanses cells from toxins.
Restoring is a means of improving cognitive function and increasing energy.

blocks.text: Abbott Laboratories

The company has been in the market since 1888 when it was created by American pharmacist George Abbott. Having started with vitamins and dietary supplements, the company is now known for its medical innovations, and its Freestyle Libre glucose sensors have become a real breakthrough in the biohacking market. This product allows users to track their blood sugar levels without invasive procedures. Abbott was one of the first companies to offer non-invasive health monitoring methods, giving users a new level of freedom and control with a [high level of accuracy](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1089/dia.2019.0262). Now, every biohacker can monitor their metabolism and adjust their diet and physical activity.

Dr Vegan

James Wright and Clayton Thomas founded the company in 2017 and made it the basis for plant-based nutrition. All of their products are vegan and eco-friendly. They emphasized the transparency of the composition, which meets the growing demand for “clean” supplements and environmental concerns. Dr. Vegan helps to promote vegan supplements and supports sustainable consumption. The company’s products do not contain synthetic additives and artificial flavors, which appeals to consumers looking for safe and effective health solutions.
Product portfolio:

items: Vegan Vitamin D3 – vegan vitamin D3 helps maintain bone health and the immune system.
Vegan Omega 3 – a supplement with a plant-based source of omega-3, which supports the cardiovascular system.
Vegan Multivitamin – a complex of vitamins and minerals created to improve overall health.
Vegan Immune Support – a supplement to strengthen the immune system with plant extracts and antioxidants.

blocks.text: NutriSense

In 2019, Dan Zavorotny, Cara Collier, and Alex Skryl founded a company that today offers a technology solution for monitoring it using sensors. NutriSense provides a new generation of health treatment tools. It is an excellent opportunity to be aware of and balance your blood sugar levels. People can track how food affects glucose levels and metabolism. Also, it has personalized dietary recommendations.
NutriSense takes an individual approach to health and nutrition, providing users with real-world data that can improve their well-being and performance.
Product portfolio:

items: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) – blood glucose monitoring sensors that track changes in blood sugar in real time.
Personalized Nutrition Plans – [personalized diet](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2015.11.001) and lifestyle recommendations based on sensor data.
Health Coaching – client support in the form of consultations with experts based on analysis of data from the CGM.

blocks.text: The Genius Brand

The company helps consumers switch to more natural supplements to enhance physical and mental performance, which is especially important in an increasing interest in healthy lifestyles and “clean” products. Founded in 2018 by Mitch Gould, Larry Stevens, and Johnny Kay, The Genius Brand aims to support people who play sports. The company does not use artificial ingredients or chemical additives, and its products are developed with an emphasis on effectiveness and safety.
Product portfolio:

items: Genius Brand Pre-Workout is a pre-workout supplement that increases energy, focus, and endurance.
Genius Sleep is a product to [improve sleep](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-sleep) and recovery, containing natural ingredients for better rest.
Genius Mind is a supplement to [enhance cognitive function](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-to-biohack-brain-health) and concentration.
Genius Mushroom is a supplement with mushroom extracts that supports immunity and overall body tone.
Genius BCAA is a branched-chain amino acid for post-workout recovery.

blocks.text: OsteoStrong

The company’s primary goal is bones. OsteoStrong was founded in 2013 by Dr. John Jaquish and uses innovative exercise machines that [help improve bone density](https://doi.org/10.1210/clinem/dgaf077) through mechanical loading. This is especially important for older people who suffer from osteoporosis or want to prevent its development. OsteoStrong offers a solution for strengthening bones and joints that do not depend on traditional pharmaceutical methods. This creates an alternative to the usual approaches to treating bone and joint diseases.
Product portfolio:

items: OSTEOstrong Machines – specialized exercise machines for strengthening bone mass and improving bone density.
Bone Strength Program – an exercise and consultation program to prevent osteoporosis and improve bone density.
OsteoStrong Wellness is a comprehensive program for strengthening bones and joints and increasing overall physical activity.

blocks.text: Leela Quantum Tech

The company was founded in 2018 by Leela D. Although the founder’s name is not disclosed, Leela Quantum Tech has an interesting and narrow focus – quantum technologies in biohacking. The company believes this approach can improve human health by restoring its energy field. This is a somewhat controversial but fascinating area of ​​​​biohacking. Leela Quantum Tech is actively developing quantum biohacking, showing how new technologies can be used to improve energy and health. This approach attracts people seeking alternative methods of improving health.
Product portfolio:

items: Leela Quantum Energy Card – a card that uses quantum technology to improve a person’s energy state and protect against adverse environmental impacts.
Leela Quantum Pendant – a pendant that, according to the company, can improve a person’s bioenergy field.
Leela Quantum Home – indoor energy field enhancement devices that impact the environment around them to increase energy and balance.

blocks.text: ODIN

Founder Josie Zayner created ODIN in 2014 to make genetic engineering accessible to a wider audience. A former NASA employee, she left her job in 2016 to focus on building the company, inspired by the open-source movement that became popular in the 1990s in computer technology.
Product portfolio:

items: Kit for genetic editing of bacteria using [CRISPR](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/gene-therapy-cell-therapy-and-crispr).
Kit for creating genetic constructs.
Kit with bacteria that glow like jellyfish.

blocks.text: TOP Biohacking Startups

In addition to large companies, the biohacking market is filled with startups that promise to change the world. There are innovations for every taste, but we have highlighted the most impressive and useful ones.
Halo Neuroscience

Halo Neuroscience was founded in 2013 by scientists and entrepreneurs, including Daniel Chao and Dr. Jason McFadden. The company’s main goal is to train the brain, so it developed a device for electrical neurostimulation. The device [enhances neuroplasticity](https://doi.org/10.3389/fnhum.2022.758891), allowing users to quickly master new skills and improve physical and mental productivity. Halo technology stimulates brain processes, which makes learning and training more effective, opening up new opportunities for athletes and people seeking to improve their cognitive abilities.
Editas Medicine

Editas is one of the most ambitious companies in biohacking, which works at the intersection of medicine and genetics, promising a revolution in the field of life extension and treatment of chronic diseases. The company was founded in 2013 by a group of scientists, including Dr. Feng Zhang, Dr. George Church, Dr. J. Keith Joung, and other specialists in the field of genetics and biotechnology. Editas Medicine uses CRISPR technology to edit the genome and treat genetic diseases. In the future, the company plans to use gene therapy to slow down aging.

Biohacking is a system of methods and technologies for optimizing the body’s biological processes to improve health, longevity, and productivity. It combines knowledge from medicine, biology, nutritional science, and psychology and is applied to develop personalized strategies for improving health and slowing aging. Aging is not only an […] [Read The Full Article](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-biohacking-can-reverse-aging)
Oura Ring

Oura Ring is an innovative solution for those who want to monitor their health without bulky devices. It is a smart ring that gives the user accurate data on their health and helps to track parameters such as sleep, activity, body temperature, and stress levels. This compact device collects important health information without interfering with the user’s normal lifestyle. The company was founded in 2013 by Finnish entrepreneurs Petteri Lahtela, Kari Kivelä, and Markku Koskela.
[The study shows](https://www.jmir.org/2022/1/e27487) that the Oura Ring accurately measures nocturnal heart rate and heart rate variability compared to electrocardiography.
What’s With a Future Prediction?

The biohacking industry is growing fast, so we can predict its increasing development in the coming years. Possibly, we will see profound changes in the field of health. One of the main topics in the biohacking startups is preserving youth and wellbeing. To reach success in this field, AI, neurotechnology, and genetic engineering are working together to not only treat diseases but also prevent them and improve the quality of life. Talking about the leading players on this field, we should highlight the following:

items: Apple has developed biohacking gadgets to help people track their health.
Bulletproof is working on nootropic supplements to improve the human body. With these products, a person could stay focused and have more energy for the day.
The ODIN is trying to democratize genetic engineering and make CRISPR kits affordable.

blocks.text: Each year, it becomes clear: the future belongs to personalized biohacking, where everyone can get tools to optimize health and increase productivity. And with innovations such as genetic editing or neurostimulation, we are only on the threshold of a real revolution in medicine and health.
